hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */services/api/*.py) d="${f%%/services/api/*}/services/api"; out=$(cd "$d" && uvx ruff check --no-cache --output-format concise "$f" 2>&1) || jq -n --arg o "$out" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:("ruff check 发现问题，修正后再继续：\n" + $o)}}' ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
